docs: Compare content: the heading, a description, the names of the two options and an ordered list of rows, each a feature with the value of each option. One object is valid in every compare layout (a table, cards).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

firstLabel.docs: the name of the first option

secondLabel.docs: the name of the second option

rows.docs: the rows, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

first.docs: the value of the first option

second.docs: the value of the second option
